create_stack_manipulation_task: create a StackManipulation task instance to generate stack manipulation training data
sample_batch_stack_manipulation: sample a batch of stack manipulation expressions with POP and PUSH actions using a JAX PRNG key
test_sample_expression_and_result: test the _sample_expression_and_result method to generate a stack expression and its computed result
test_accuracy_mask: test the accuracy_mask method to compute a mask that ignores predictions after the termination token
review_output_length: review the output_length method that returns input_length plus one for the termination token
